tasks.short: Communicate using a student's alternative communication method

steps.what: Open the student's established computer communications vocabulary and access settings
Communicate with students through their established sign language or computer method

tasks.design: Use the existing communication device's native shortcut to the student's established vocabulary and access profile in {OTHER}. The pathologist communicates directly at the student's pace and does not replace the student's intended message with generated content.
tasks.previous_blocker: Opening the established vocabulary can require repeated device navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native profile shortcut removes navigation without changing language or access choices.
tasks.still_hard: Meaning, pace and confirmation depend on the individual student's communication method.
tasks.human_edge: Wait, notice uncertainty and check that the intended meaning is understood.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: established alternative-communication device profiles can reduce navigation while live supported communication remains human.

assumptions: OTHER means the student's existing alternative-communication device and sign-language interaction. The scenario uses the statement's computer-technology alternative; a sign-only exchange has no device-navigation opportunity.
The student and responsible communication team have already established vocabulary and access settings. s1 includes opening and checking that setup, not new assessment or vocabulary capture.

s1 removes one unit of repeated navigation, retaining nine for access and readiness checks. All90 communication units remain. Student effort is not reduced or transferred, and no automated message send is proposed.

This task is reciprocal communication, not a separate clinical encounter note or progress report; no such trailing record is invented. Ordinary device state saving is negligible and ungated. Existing shortcuts already used earn no new saving.
unknowns: Whether the established device already opens the correct profile
research_questions: Does the shortcut preserve the student's familiar access method?

already_counted.description: Open and check the established interface and communicate directly

incremental.description: Keep the native shortcut aligned with the existing communication profile

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R99 gross1 less upkeep0.5 gives0.5. On a device already close to the required vocabulary, setup retains9.5 of10 and communication90; gross0.5 is offset by upkeep0.5. No conversation time, invented note or same-system save supplies a saving.

tasks.short: Conduct research and report speech or hearing findings

steps.what: Define the speech or hearing research question, method and analysis plan
Conduct or direct the actual speech or hearing research observations
Enter and verify actual speech or hearing observations in the research dataset
Calculate the specified research summaries and assemble traceable result tables
Write the research findings, interpretation and limitations for procedure development
outputs: complete findings report and recipient list

steps.what: Review the final research findings and limitations before the agreed report distribution
inputs: complete findings report and recipient list

steps.what: Send the exact reviewed research findings to the agreed procedure-development recipients

tasks.design: Generate prespecified result tables from the checked research dataset in {OTHER} and {SPREADSHEET}, then reuse the report structure in {DOCS}. The pathologist writes the interpretation and limitations, the actual research lead reviews the complete report, and only that version goes to the agreed recipients through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculation and result-table assembly sit between study conduct and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Prespecified calculations and report structures can be automated without making scientific conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Study quality, confounding, missing data and implications for treatment require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the evidence does not support a proposed procedure or treatment change.

ambition.what: Scientific interpretation and practice implications remain with the research team.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: prespecified research summaries and traceable tables can be generated deterministically while interpretation and report review remain human.

assumptions: OTHER means the study's existing research data-capture tool. This is a real institutional project with a research lead and an existing reviewed findings report used in development, not an invented publication approval workflow.

The pathologist specifies variables, units, inclusion rules and calculations in s1 and captures and checks observation id, measure, unit, date and missingness in s2b. Manual extraction and checking are included there; no clean dataset is supplied free.

s3 replaces actual manual summaries and table assembly, not design or inferential judgement. Missing or incompatible measures stop for funded manual repair. Native analysis exports are tested before custom code; existing runtime earns no labour saving.

s4 removes three units of repeated report structure and table placement, retaining17 for meaning, limitations and checking. Ordinary author save is negligible, fully retained and ungated. s5 is existing independent scientific review, not an author approving her notes.

The send binds the exact report and recipients reviewed in s5; edits invalidate that approval. Send time remains fully retained. No treatment change, participant recruitment or regulatory submission is automated.
unknowns: Actual research review and data-access arrangements
research_questions: Can every table cell be traced to the specified analysis and checked observations?

already_counted.description: Specify research, conduct and capture it, interpret and write findings and send the reviewed report
Existing research lead reviews report meaning and distribution

incremental.description: Maintain analysis scripts and repair missing or incompatible research fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact findings report, limitations and recipient list reviewed by the research lead in s5; edits invalidate distribution authority

role.altitude: The pathologist keeps personal communication and scientific judgement while removing narrow navigation and research-table work.
reach: Support traceable research summaries for procedure-development colleagues
skills_to_grow: Specify reproducible research variables and calculations
role.ambitious_version: The pathologist gives students attentive communication support and colleagues carefully interpreted research with traceable results.
